description: Keep an accurate inventory of devices, services, applications, and cloud resources in scope.
why_it_matters: You cannot reliably prioritize or remediate assets you do not know exist.
priority_tags: Vulnerability management;Cloud security;Network security;Endpoint protection;Compliance support

description: Identify, prioritize, remediate, and verify vulnerabilities using asset context and trusted advisories.
why_it_matters: Supports a repeatable response to vulnerabilities, including items listed in CISA KEV.

description: Collect important security logs, restrict access to them, and review alerts through a defined process.
why_it_matters: Centralized visibility can help teams investigate suspicious activity and detect gaps in coverage.
priority_tags: Security monitoring;Incident response readiness;Network security;Endpoint protection

control_name: Use strong identity and access practices
description: Use unique accounts, least privilege, multifactor authentication where available, and periodic access review.
why_it_matters: Reduces unnecessary access and improves control over sensitive systems.
priority_tags: Identity and access management;Cloud security;Compliance support

description: Define roles, escalation paths, communications, evidence handling, and recovery steps; practice them periodically.
why_it_matters: A rehearsed process can improve coordination when a security event occurs.

description: Track software components, review dependencies, and include security checks in development and release workflows.
why_it_matters: Helps teams identify vulnerable components before and after deployment.
priority_tags: Vulnerability management;Cloud security;Security awareness and learning;Compliance support

control_name: Back up critical data and test recovery
description: Maintain protected backups and periodically test whether critical data and services can be restored.
why_it_matters: Backups are only useful if they are available, intact, and recoverable when needed.

description: Review identity permissions, public exposure, logging, network boundaries, and configuration drift in cloud resources.
why_it_matters: Misconfiguration can undermine otherwise useful technical controls.

description: Provide role-appropriate awareness and make it easy for people to report suspicious messages or events.
why_it_matters: People need clear, practical steps for recognizing and reporting security concerns.
priority_tags: Security awareness and learning;Incident response readiness

description: Assign remediation owners and due dates, record decisions, and verify fixes after implementation.
why_it_matters: Improves accountability and helps prevent vulnerabilities from being treated as resolved without evidence.
